Build: read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528. I ran no git command against it. Afterwards there was no configs/source_qualification.yml in it and no file newer than my seed outside its audit/ log folder.

App: started by /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/S/launch.py, a copy of the re-checker's launcher with only the paths changed.
- It drops every *proxy* variable plus OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, sets cwd and PYTHONPATH to the tree, imports src.api.main and calls main() (never -m). The log confirms 'SRC FROM /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree/src/api/main.py'.
- Environment: OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1, OO_AUTOSEED=0, OO_LLM_AUTOSTART=0, OO_PORT=9624, OO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/S/data.
- It points qualification_overlay.DEFAULT_OVERLAY_PATH at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/S/configs/source_qualification.yml, so the S7 overlay was never written into the tree.
- `--small` injects machine_floor._mem_readings = (3924, 800) for S10.

Seed: fresh, built by this build. No old data folder was copied, so there was no stale briefing_cache.json. scheduler_settings.json {"scrape_unqualified": true} was written first. Then the row's seed.py (the 2026-09-18 admission seed, sys.path pointed at the new tree) ran from the tree with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026 and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. It printed 11 sources, 3 collecting, 3 admission events (1 undone), 2 of 3 unaccounted.

Data folders under /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/S/:
- data.snapshot: the fresh seed.
- data.after-main-walk: the state after S1–S9.
- data.after-s10: the state after the S10 boots.
- phase D ran on a fresh copy of the snapshot.

Encryption proof: the DB header is b'\xf9\x11\xbb\xeb…', not 'SQLite format 3'. /api/system/lock-state read {state: locked, plaintext_mode: false} at all four boots: main PID 21738, small-memory 24944, OO_ALLOW_BIG_SCANS override 25939, fresh copy 26965. Each boot was unlocked in Chromium through #pw / #btn-unlock. All servers were stopped by PID only.

Airplane proof:
- Each OO_NO_SCHEDULER boot started online. The first action each time was one real click on #net-toggle. The toasts read 'Going offline — cutting new network requests…' and 'Offline — every new network request is refused…', #net-plane fill became currentColor, and /api/system/network read online:false. No consent popup appears for that direction.
- The page request listener recorded zero non-loopback requests in every phase.
- The one consent popup this row reaches ('Qualify the backlog') was opened three times: main boot en, override boot en, override boot fr. Each time I read it, screenshotted it (S-X-consent-qualify-main-en.png, S-S10-override-press_en-consent.png, S-S10-override-press_fr-consent.png) and cancelled with 'Stay offline'.
